entityDescription: At Quaesta AI we deliver solutions based on the most advanced methodologies and algorithms from Deep Learning and Artificial Intelligence, for tasks where standard methods often fail. Thanks to more than a decade of experience in scientific research, our solutions are based on state-of-the-art algorithms for computer vision, with applications in remote sensing and quality control, addressing demanding standards of quality and performance. Our experience focuses on remote sensing applications based on satellite and drone images, with both visible and non-visible (multispectral and hyperspectral) bands. Among the others, we have developed solutions for the identification of specific vegetation species and undergroud large structure of possible archeological interest using satellite data, as well as for the detection of landslides using SAR and multispectral bands. Additionally, we develop software solutions for ensuring quality control, with a focus on manufacturing processes characterized by the need of high performance, both in terms of speed (minimal latency), robustness and of accuracy of the system. Our software allows tasks such as anomaly detection, barcode and QR codes decoding, OCR/OCV, and many other typical tasks in visual-based quality control automation. We are one of the few companies developing ad-hoc software for neuromorphic (Event-Based) cameras, a revolutionary family of cameras capable of capturing information from scenes at extremely high frequency and in low-light and high-contrast conditions. Our software is not bound to any specific camera brand or computer platform, allowing a straightforward adoption and integration in existing production environments.

We also develop our in-house heat pump connected to a microturbine to enhance the global efficiency and an ORC system for waste heat recovery. We therefore combine all the building blocks required to be efficient/hybrid solutions comaptible with renewables for the heating industry.

LIDAX Electro Optical Systems (Hereafter LIDAX EOS) is a space technological company located in Paracuellos de Jarama Madrid (Spain) 
Its main objective is the development and commercialization of custom electro-optical systems for space to reduce time to market of functional products that can support a variety of space applications. 

An imaging scanning lidar for Space applications SMARTLID3 is currently one of its main projects references.
LIDAX EOS is a subsidiary of LIDAX GROUP, the parent organization has more than 22 years of expertise and 15 senior space engineers and technicians with advanced laboratories and equipment to develop complex Space Flight equipment used in Instruments for Earth Observation, Planetary Exploration and Telecom, Astrophysics Instrumentation for Satellites, On ground Science and Astronomical Instrumentation Projects.
The above-mentioned space family of products are:
• Opto-Mechanical Subsystems.
• Focal Plane Assemblies (FPAs) for Electro-Optical systems.
• High Performance Mechanism.
• Optical Ground Support Equipment.
Some relevant projects to which LIDAX has contributed are the James Webb Space Telescope, Meteosat Third Generation MTG, Earthcare ATLID, BepiColombo MIX-C & MIX-T, Exomars 2020. 

This extensive experience ensures their support on the success for a RDV/GNC Scanning LIDAR product development, where LIDAX EOS is the spearhead that will lead as product owner its development and commercialization.
LIDAX EOS carries out the following activities in a fully integrated center of 1,800 m2:

· System Engineering / Chief Engineering activities.
· Assembly and Integration areas for any opto-electronics device(In ISO 7/5 Cleanrooms).
· Testing laboratory for the complete functional validation for any opto-electronic device.
 
SMARTLID3 project is being developed together with a technological partner specialized on terrestrial LIDARs, based on a long term commitment between both companies.

entityDescription: The regional agency for prevention, environment and energy of Emilia-Romagna (Arpae) was established with regional law n.13/2015 and has been operational since 1 January 2016. Arpae is structured in multiple offices per territorial unit, to guarantee direct coverage of the territory. Arpae carries out authorization, concession, monitoring of the environmental state, supervision and control and analytical analysis activities and adds, to the environmental protection activities, those aimed at the energy field, the "e" in its acronym. The Agency promotes the sustainability of human activities that influence the environment, health and territorial safety, both through the controls required by the regulations and through prevention activities in the issuing of environmental authorizations and concessions, studies, projects, environmental communication .

entityName: ARPAL - Agenzia Regionale per la Protezione dell'Ambiente Ligure
entityDescription:
RPAL is the public reference body in environmental matters, in charge of monitoring the regional environment and of controlling the potential pollution sources. It is operational since 1 January 1998 in support of the Region, Provinces, Municipalities for the protection of environment, biodiversity, water resources and soil, and for the prevention and promotion of collective health and safety.
ARPAL is part of the National System for Environmental protection, together with all other regional Agencies and ISPRA, the Italian Central Institute for Environmental Protection and Applied Research. ARPAL takes also part to the National Civil Protection System, including the Regional Meteorological and Hydrologic Center (RMHC) of Civil Protection, which carries out daily weather forecasts and rainfall measures as well as river level monitoring and discharge forecast with several products. It uses a meteo-hydrological forecasting chain the couples the meteorological models with the hydrological model, DRiFt, that allows to forecast river discharge over the main catchments of Liguria region, in a probabilistic context.

entityDescription:
Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography of Poland (GUGiK) is a national mapping agency.
The role of Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography is to provide access to current geodetic and cartographic information andco-creating a modern spatial data infrastructure. The tasks carried out by Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography result mainly from two basic legal acts:
- Act of 17 May1989 on geodetic and cartographic law.

- Act of 4 March 2010 on spatial information infrastructure.
The most important tasks of GUGiK include:
- supervising realisation of the national policy in the scope of land surveying and cartography,
- maintaining theNational Geodetic and Cartographic Resources,
- maintaining records in the systems of information on lands with general state importance,
- granting professional qualifications in the area of land surveying and cartography,
- creating and maintaining the geoportal of spatial information, as the central access point for services (such as searching, reviewing, downloading and transforming) within a full thematic and territorial range of infrastructure,
- being responsible for contacts with the European Commission.The Surveyor General of Poland has been appointed as the National Contact Point on issues relating to the INSPIRE Directive.
